room.what_it_is: BYU Clyde Building (CB) room 154, 1st floor, Provo UT: the Vertical Cloud Lab's lab (Sterling Baird's group; formerly 'the old projects lab'). An L-shaped interior of about 9.60 m E-W x 7.87 m N-S (378" x 310") minus a 4.09 x 2.60 m notch (room 158) in the NW corner. That is about 65 m^2 / 700 ft^2 with painted CMU walls, a bare concrete floor, and an exposed ceiling (usable height ~2.62 m). Main entrance is on the west wall from corridor 101. It holds a 14x10x9 ft steel clean room in the NE corner for the AMAZEMET rePowder atomizer, new sink/eyewash casework on the south wall, and a wall-hung L-counter in the SW corner carrying the CubXL and the OT-2.

room.notes: HOW DERIVED: cb154.pdf and cb154-annotated.pdf are raster prints (Microsoft Print-to-PDF, 17x11 in, author sgbaird, 2026-01-28) of BYU Facilities Planning's 'CB 1st Floor' sheet (Revit database 12/6/2024) with everything except CB154, the hallways and part of CB123 whited out (issue #31). Stated scale 1"=25'-0". Measured at 600 dpi, room 154 is 308.5" x 376", against Gage's tape (310" x 378") and the annotation callouts (25.78 x 31.38 ft); they agree within 0.5%, so the sheet is to scale. Positions come from plan pixels (scaled to Gage's envelope) cross-checked with Gage's sketch, which is the plan rotated 180 degrees. The ANNOTATED PDF carries dimension callouts only: 25.78/31.38 ft room, 10.29 ft east wall->pillar, 4.67 ft north wall->pillar, 8.53 ft north wall->158, 3.86 ft entrance door, and move-in path widths 7.94 ft (corridor 101), 7.89 ft (east corridor), 5.87 ft (double door into 123). NO EQUIPMENT IS ANNOTATED on it. Equipment-annotated versions exist elsewhere: Gage's outlet-star map (#31), Josh's A-E photo board (#229), and Claude's cb154-arm-locations.png render (branch claude/issue-229-20260925-0253, which also derived 7.8 x 9.6 m). WALL-BY-WALL: West = corridor wall (brick outside), with the L-counter leg B, the roll-up service window, the OT-2, a thermostat/switch, and the 48" entrance door about 0.5-0.6 m south of 158. South = counter A with black upper storage and the CubXL, a whiteboard, the 154A door (swings out), a pilaster, and the new sink/eyewash casework to the SE corner (the west part of this wall is smooth plaster, the rest CMU). East = door 154-2 near the SE corner, then the clean room's back wall. North = clean room, the transformer pocket, the free-standing pillar ~1.4-1.6 m off the wall, and locked door 154-1 hard against 158. UNCERTAINTIES: pillar distance to the north wall (plan 1416 vs Gage 1638 mm); entrance-door centre +/-150 mm; window position +/-250 mm and size; clean-room doorway positions; atomizer placement inside the enclosure is undocumented (install Mon Sep 28, 2026, 2 days after this research); transformer size unknown; furniture (island, desks, gray cabinet, dehumidifier, vacuum) is mobile. Ceiling: no dropped ceiling. Whether the room is sprinklered was not confirmed. Floor: bare/sealed concrete with no tiles, so there is no floor-tile scale; corridor 101 has 12" VCT. NOT IN CB154: the Lansmont drop tower (tensegrity-optimization project; Jeff Hill's lab, described as 'pretty close to CB 154'). The glovebox is not bought yet; the vertical lift module and the Mastrex metal printer are planned only. No record places the powder doser or the induction furnace in 154. Adjacent spaces: 158 (NW notch), 123 (east, via 154-2), 154A (south, carpeted lab of another group), 148 (south-west), and the neighbouring lab north of 154-1 (sealed). Utilities per #31/#124/#24: new 40 A-fused disconnects, chilled water (1" to the heat exchanger; wall drops ~3/4"), compressed air run along the south wall with a T to the east wall, argon (5N, 8 bar at the machine), exhaust hookup, ethernet, an O2 detector, and HEPA/dehumidifier air feeding the clean room.

room.origin_convention: Origin (0,0,0) = inside SW corner of room 154 at floor level: intersection of the inner face of the SOUTH wall (shared with 154A/148) and the inner face of the WEST wall (corridor-101 wall with the main entrance), ignoring the corner column. +x = east along the long north/south walls (0 -> 9601), +y = north along the east/west walls (0 -> 7874), +z = up from the bare concrete floor. Compass follows the plan's north arrow, which points to PAGE-LEFT on cb154.pdf (page-top = east). Gage's hand sketch in #7 is the plan rotated 180 degrees. Feature x_mm/y_mm = footprint centre; w_mm = extent along x (E-W), d_mm = extent along y (N-S). Doors/windows are centred on the wall mid-thickness (x<0 is inside the west wall, y<0 inside the south wall, etc.) with the wall thickness as the across-wall extent. Room 158 occupies x 0-4090, y 5274-7874 and is not part of 154. Imperial values converted at 25.4 mm/in.
